cards.text: Abijah, king of Judah, rests with his fathers and is buried in the City of David. His son Asa reigns in his place, and in his days the land is at peace for ten years. I bet all of Judah is leaning in like it's the first day with a new boss: okay, buddy, what are YOU gonna be like?

cards.question: True or false: King Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

cards.text: And Asa gets to WORK: he removes the foreign altars and high places, shatters the sacred pillars and chops DOWN the Asherah poles. That's not tidying up, friend, that's the deep clean where even the junk drawer gets emptied, and as a stamper who spent YEARS in the back of one, I know how rare THAT is.

cards.question: King Asa has cleared out the foreign altars. Then what does he command the people of Judah to do?

answers.text: Seek the LORD and keep His law
Build a new temple in Jerusalem

cards.text: He also removes the high places and incense altars from all the cities of Judah. And under Asa, the kingdom is at peace.

cards.question: With Judah at peace, King Asa builds ___ cities in Judah.
In those days no one made war with King Asa, because the LORD had given him ___.

cards.text: Asa tells the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars.” Friend, that's locking the door, bolting it AND shoving a chair under the handle.

cards.question: True or false: King Asa tells Judah the land is still theirs because their army is the strongest around.

cards.text: So Judah builds and prospers. And Asa has an army of mighty men of valor: 300,000 from Judah with large shields and spears, and 280,000 from Benjamin with small shields and bows.
Then Zerah the Cushite, a man from the land of Cush, comes against Judah with an army of 1,000,000 men and 300 chariots. They advance as far as Mareshah.
So Asa marches out and lines up for battle in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah. 580,000 against a MILLION is not a battle line, friend, that's a whole stadium showing up at your front door.

cards.question: King Asa is lined up in the Valley of Zephathah, facing Zerah's million men. What does Asa do?

answers.text: He cries out to the LORD his God
He sends messengers to ask for peace
He pulls his army back to Jerusalem

cards.question: True or false: In his prayer, King Asa says there is no one besides the LORD to help the powerless against the mighty.
Facing Zerah's million men, King Asa prays and tells the LORD what Judah is relying on. What is it?
King Asa has prayed. What happens to Zerah's Cushite army?

answers.text: The LORD strikes them down and they flee
They surrender and pay Asa tribute
They camp and wait for more troops

cards.text: Asa and his army chase the Cushites as far as Gerar.

cards.question: True or false: After the chase to Gerar, the Cushites regroup and come back at Judah for another round.
Judah carries off plunder and attacks all the cities around Gerar, because the ___ of the LORD had fallen upon those cities.

cards.text: They raid the herdsmen's tents for many sheep and camels, then head home to Jerusalem. And that's where we'll leave King Asa for now, but stick around, friend, because his story is far from done.
